checks.name: Vite code build without copying public media

resolvedEarlierCheckFailure.cause: copyPublicDir was initially passed at the top level, so Vite copied public media and exhausted space in its newly created private build directory.
resolvedEarlierCheckFailure.resolution: Removed only that private output and reran with build.copyPublicDir=false; final exit code0. No source art or project data was removed.
